_note: KAI-1480 Phase 1 registry. Each entry is a stateful store that must NEVER silently vanish: the custodian (scripts/protected_resource_custodian.py, cron */1) + the green baseline (check_protected_resources) verify each still exists, is bound to the RIGHT container at the RIGHT mount, and passes its integrity invariant. Add a store here to protect it. Phase 2 will additionally require external:true + an approval-gated veto on destructive ops.

resources.name: buzz-minio-data
resources.why: Buzz object storage — the KAI-1475 8-day outage was this store rebound to an empty volume.

resources.name: buzz-postgres-data
resources.why: Buzz approval database — backs the Leo approval surface.

resources.why: Buzz cache/queue — may be empty legitimately, so only liveness is asserted.

resources.why: Advisor/council vector memory — a wiped store is silent knowledge loss.
